title.narrative: In 2023, UNICEF enhanced its advocacy efforts, strengthening relationships with the public sector at national and local level. Three advocacy priorities were selected: Immunization, Education and Social Protection, with Child Protection remaining a key priority for the office. UNICEF engaged directly with 12 ministers, 9 governors or vices, mayors, and other stakeholders, opening doors for concrete policies for children and adolescents. UNICEF also invested in engaging the private sector, working closely with 40 donors. UNICEF strengthened its presence in the media, ensuring high visibility for UNICEF&39;s advocacy priorities, leading to the coverage of 444 TV reports by key broadcasters.
